validation.calculation: Ibrexafungerp: 2 x 150 mg per dose x 2 doses = 600 mg/day; strong CYP3A inhibitor: 1 x 150 mg x 2 = 300 mg/day.
validation.oteseconazoleCalculation: 150 mg capsules: monotherapy 4 + 3 + 11 = 18 capsules; combination sequence 7 + 11 = 18 oteseconazole capsules plus 3 separately prescribed fluconazole 150 mg doses. Weekly dates must follow the selected schedule.
